name: How long does a typical drywall crack repair take?

mainEntity.name: How long does a typical drywall crack repair take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of a drywall crack repair depends on its size and the number of cracks. Small hairline crack repairs can often be completed within a few hours, including drying time for joint compound and paint. More extensive repairs, especially those requiring multiple coats of compound or addressing underlying issues, might take a day or two. Proper drying time between coats is crucial for a durable finish.
acceptedAnswer.description: Small drywall crack repairs can take a few hours. Larger or more complex repairs, especially with underlying issues, may take one to two days, including drying time.
